authorization_basis: Existing manifest acknowledgement and contributor instructions to publish the baseline and progress data, then reorganize the same case under its UUID and USER_ONE pseudonym. This is a publication-scope record, not a signed consent form.
date_retention_basis: Existing case-specific contributor request to retain acquisition and treatment dates; dates remain confined to case records, not the catalog.
rights_note: The pre-existing third-party simulation remains in media/reference-simulation.mp4 with its existing rights caveat. This migration does not establish redistribution rights; the video is excluded from the server public-asset allowlist. Raw CBCT, private records, and original identifying paperwork are excluded.
